name: iter_money_policies
description: MONEY RUN - the paper's four-policy comparison at the scarcity operating point, 30 seeds. The showcase search found the first statistically significant across-the-loop guided wins (Adaptive severity, alpha0 0.5, deficit 0.98: sigma 0.15/radius 0.25 auc -0.035 p=0.028; sigma 0.30/radius 0.35 auc -0.024 p=0.005), and that a narrow kernel WITHOUT the gate fails - the severity-adaptive mix is what makes hard focus safe. This run puts all four policies (Constant, Exponential dump x0.1, Adaptive severity, Adaptive size) at both showcase geometries with doubled seeds, giving the final table/figure: under persistent scarcity the severity gate wins, the dump ties, constant is marginal, the size gate fails. n_train 30, n_select 100, K=8.
